_comment: Read by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs.confined: directories the startup chunk may take only the listed modules from. infrastructure: lazy-only exports the shell provides to screens BY DESIGN, each with its reason; add one only with a reason a reviewer can check. debt: known leaks, shrink-only by hand; `npm run bundle:record` prunes paid-off entries and files only what the shell itself stopped using. The copy entries are the copy system's: messages only lazy code says belong in a lazy .ftl, and formatters only screens call in their own module.

confined.why: the shell calls the client through api/shell.ts, the startup endpoints only. A domain object or the composed api ships whole, with every method any screen adds.

infrastructure.why: the one request boundary: every domain module calls its verbs, isNotFound reads its ApiError, and the kept answers check writesSettled, the count of writes it sends; the shell needs the module for its own calls.
a context the shell provides; the hook must live beside the context it reads.
hooks every switching screen calls, and the supervised jobs and the prices epoch the status poll carries; they read the SyncState context the shell provides.
the copy runtime every lazy catalog chunk and formatter calls; the shell's own messages need the module.

the shell asks a configured install the sharing question from the state it read at startup; the welcome answers that question on its own screen and tells the shell through this, so leaving setup never asks again what was just answered.

first-run setup's one answer, read once and shared: the shell mutes the app from it, Welcome and Profile enter and leave setup through it, and the board and Profile drop their way back into setup when a save forgets it, so they never disagree.
